law_name: Copyright Act, Cap. 300 (Copyright Act 1998, No. 4 of 1998; revised to 2006; amended by Act No. 17 of 2004)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (anonymous works publication + 50 years; audiovisual works creation/publication + 50 years)
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (infringement of moral rights is addressed in the 1998 Act; articles not seen) (unconfirmed)
digital_protection: Treaty obligations not yet incorporated into the 1998 Act as of 2020 (IIPA); encrypted broadcast provision exists (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing for research and private study, criticism, review and reporting (headings seen on a Barbados Government Printery page) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Corporate Affairs and Intellectual Property Office (CAIPO)
notes: WPPT in force 13 December 2019 (WIPO notification, deposit 13 Sept 2019); WCT same period per Commons; Berne since 1983 and WTO since 1995 per Commons. WIPO Lex text seen is the 1982 Act; the 1998 Act text was not read.
